docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-25-2024 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-25-2024 BY JUDGE PRO TEM. PLAINTIFF NICHOLAS LOUIS BARELLA APPEARED. DEFENDANT HUMANMADE APPEARED, REPRESENTED BY SANDRA SPURLOCK, DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS AND RYAN SPURLOCK, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. BOTH EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE DAWN PAYNE, CLERK: A. MOK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-25-2024 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BARELLA, NICHOLAS LOUIS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HUMANMADE $750.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $800.00, PLAINTIFF FAILED TO PROVE HE WAS ENTITLED TO DAMAGES UNDER BUSINESS & PROFESSIONS CODE SECTION 17602. NONETHELESS, THE COURT CONCLUDES DEFENDANT SHOULD PAY $750 FOR A 3 MONTH REFUND GIVEN MISUNDERSTANDING CONCERNING BILLING & ITS PAST PRACTICES. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
